 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Ravens are facing another change at kicker with Tyler Loop already on injured reserve.
 Atlanta is signing Jake Moody from Baltimore's practice squad to its 53-man roster, according to Jordan Schultz. The reported move leaves the Ravens needing another option after Moody handled kicking duties during Thursday's 33-10 loss to Jacksonville.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Moody connected on a 53-yard field goal against the Jaguars , giving Baltimore its first points on a rainy night at M&T Bank Stadium. His departure comes as the Ravens prepare to visit the Los Angeles Chargers on Monday night, giving them a limited window to identify and prepare a replacement.
 Baltimore placed Loop on injured reserve Nov. 3 with a right groin injury. The move created an opening for Moody, who had been serving as an experienced alternative on the practice squad.
